reason: The facies assets expose independent 2D patches with inline/crossline metadata, but no verifiable continuous 3D volume, voxel lattice, or ordered spatial traversal that would justify a native_volume or spatial_context 3D rendering.

facts: 2D patches must not be stacked into a fake 3D volume
not_feasible is required when no verifiable third dimension exists
metadata stores inline/crossline/time_ms but not a dense 3D volume
visualization stacks 2D test patches as rows
selection uses deterministic test-patch quantiles, not volumetric ordering
evidence records test indices and inline numbers for 2D patches
prediction quality is not used for selection

missing_contract: No native_volume: no confirmed 3D voxel grid or continuous volume.
No spatial_context: no verified ordered 3D trajectory or Z-aligned sample sequence.
No safe 3D renderer contract: existing outputs are 2D patch diagnostics only.
No HTML/PDF/PNG 3D artifact is permitted without a real volume or spatial trajectory.
unlock_required_data: A real dense 3D voxel lattice with a documented axis convention and slice ordering.
Or a verified spatial trajectory / point cloud with continuous X/Y/Z coordinates.
Or a proven sample ordering contract that guarantees a legitimate third dimension.
